verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser ships a software product, Visalaw AI, so asking whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question. The evidence pack contains only marketing copy, a free-trial link and failed API/llms.txt probes, with no mention of a public repository, published source, or open-source license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
